bio:
I am a 2000 graduate of the Pennsylvania State University and am blessed to have made golf, my career.  Currently, I'm employed as the Director of Golf at Ron Jaworski's Valleybrook Country Club.  Prior to Valleybrook CC, I worked
 at Cool Creek CC, Grandover Golf Resort, Kennett Square Golf & CC, Hidden Creek Golf Club, and Sea Oaks Golf Club.

My teaching philosophy is centered around core fundamentals and swing principles, but also completely understanding that these cannot be applied the same to everyone.  As the coach/instructor, it's my job to adapt to you, the student!
